verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a developer-facing git client, so a built-in local shell is a fair question to ask, but the evidence pack never documents a terminal or local UNIX command execution (ls, grep, cat, tar, curl). The related items do not count: regex search, Shortcuts automation, JavaScript console logging, and server-side SSH listing commands are different features, not a local command shell.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run local UNIX commands like ls, grep, cat, tar, and curl directly in the app
